name: completeness_digest
purpose: Judge whether a change too large to show as code does everything the user asked, from a digest of it (critic_score).

fields.name: task
fields.meaning: The user's request that the change implements, in their words or a faithful summary.

fields.name: change_digest
fields.meaning: A digest of the change: the changed files, their new definitions and doc comments, not the code itself.

ask.yes: every requirement in `task` has a matching file, definition or doc comment in `change_digest`
ask.no: at least one requirement in `task` has nothing matching it in `change_digest`

gate.why: not calibrated on digests: the completeness calibration used code; measured 2026-09-27, a complete 29-hunk change scored 0.45-0.48 here
